profile.headline: Software Developer at Evolve NXT
profile.summary:
👋🏽 Hi, my name is Kevin Diaz-Lopez

🌇 Los Angeles Native, with a passion for programming and developing strategies that will grow your business

📚 Coming from humble beginnings, I was born and raised by my immigrant parents in the neighborhood of Boyle Heights. Being a first generation college graduate and the first in my family to graduate with an engineering major was rather difficult as I walked the path on my own. Participating in Formula SAE, working as a full time mechanic whilst attending school full time, leading various group projects including my senior design project, and offering my knowledge to various kids/teens at the Variety Boys & Girls Club in hopes of inspiring the youth to take on the challenge of becoming an engineer in the future.

💻 As for my future, I hope to work in any computer science related field but more specifically in the data science/machine learning field.

🏔 In my free time, you can find me going on hikes, working on cars, and listening to music (RnB, Soul, and Hip Hop are my favorite genres)

💪🏽 I'm an experienced media assistant with a demonstrated history of working in the individual and family services industry. Skilled in Java, Python,  C++, Tableau, Data Science, Data Entry, Data Analysis, and Machine Learning.

positions.title: Software Developer - Team Lead
positions.description:
-Integrate RESTful APIs, SOAP, and HTTP endpoints with OAuth2, API keys, Basic Auth, and Bearer tokens, enabling seamless compliance-driven workflows and improving customer usability.
-Develop, redesign, and contribute to Evolve's 100+ page platform to current technologies.
-Develop dynamic, configurable systems/forms that empowered clients to design UIs tailored to their needs, improving adoption and user satisfaction.
-Enhance reporting systems, reducing coding time by 89% (45 minutes → 5 minutes) and delivering faster turnaround that boosted customer satisfaction.
-Author and maintain technical documentation, tutorials, and process guides to enable internal developers, clients, and new hires to understand and extend complex systems.
-Collaborate with business analysts, QA, and product teams to translate requirements into API-driven solutions while context-switching across multiple modules and projects.
-Create and optimize APIs using Taffy and ColdFusion, exposing secure endpoints for enterprise clients, driving platform adoption across major healthcare providers.
-Work directly with external stakeholders to troubleshoot integration issues, provide technical guidance, and ensure successful onboarding to EvolveNXT’s platform.
-Debug and refactor daily issues with JavaScript, CSS, Bootstrap, SQL, and ColdFusion.
-Automate a dynamic system to efficiently process and store over 200,000 agents/brokers (biographic, contact, address, and license) information with MSSQL queries.
-Design and develop relational databases to connect essential broker/member data.
-Develop and/or modify TSQL queries, scripts, functions, and stored procedures to map, transform, and clean data.
-Extract data from servers to create downloadable reports in varying formats for the clients
-Optimize SQL queries for downloadable reports to reduce database costs

positions.title: Purchasing Assistant
positions.description:
-Calculate, generate, place, and follow up on purchase orders.
-Analyze spreadsheets of current inventory to identify opportunities and concerns.
-Maintain and update over 50,000 rows of data.
-Automate data entry processes to save company time and allow more time to be focused on new products/growth of existing products.
-Set up and manage new items on inventory spreadsheets.
-Interact with other departments professionally.
-Cultivate and maintain professional relationships with vendors.
-Assist in the search for new ERP (Enterprise resource planning) software to better manage warehouse inventory, track FBA inventory, and calculate costs to ship goods to ensure profitability.

positions.title: Business Operations Coordinator/Lead Mechanic
positions.description:
- Prepare and execute development plans for large-scale projects involving major changes to cars/trucks
- Connect with consumers on-site to answer questions and explain potential products that will be installed
- Facilitate with the operational standards and strategic business goals such as attendance of popular automotive events with previous projects to showcase company services
- Taking lead on projects that involve major changes to drivetrain, suspension, interior, or any electronics in the vehicles such as engine swaps, harness repair, instrument clusters, or aftermarket suspension
- Tuning vehicles that had aftermarket electronic computers installed using pre-made software for mobile devices

positions.title: Digital Media Assistant
positions.description:
Create an environment that facilitates the achievement of Youth Development Out-comes:
-promote and stimulate program participation;
-register new members and participate in their club orientation process; provide guidance and role modeling to members.
-Ensure that all programs and activities and organized and conducted in a professional manner and are reflective of the Boys & Girls Club philosophies
-Provide support to youth and families at all times.

positions.title: Sales Consultant
positions.description:
-Implement assigned responsibilities from store leadership in outlet area to engage customers using selling skills to build complete, connected solutions while maintaining a balance of high velocity and high service
-Ensure inventory and merchandising standards are maintained in outlet store area.
-Demonstrate excellence in execution of selling skills, and selling strategy as evidenced by coaching forms and Customer Metrics (NPS and Mystery Shops)
-Support sales strategies in partnership with the Sales Manager to achieve operating results, growth objectives, and overall financial performance goals

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.description: Undergraduate who earn a grade point average of 3.5 or higher in 12 or more units of graded course work in one semester are named to the Dean’s List. Students who receive NC for any coursework in the semester under consideration are not eligible to be named to the Dean’s List for that semester.
honors.issuer: Issued by California State University, Los Angeles · May 2021

honors.description: The Variety Club Academic Scholarship supports meritorious students who demonstrate academic and athletic commitment to the school, university and their local community
honors.issuer: Issued by Variety Boys & Girls Club · Jun 2017

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Francisco Bravo Medical Magnet High School
volunteerExperiences.description: Experience in educating athletes on dedication and teamwork. Performed research to ensure athletes receive optimal workouts and ensure they are committed to succeeding in the sport. Dedicated time to mentoring athletes on how to achieve their goals and succeeding under pressure.

projects.title: Company Website
projects.description: Extensive research in the creation of a website for a company to ensure potential/current customer interactions. Ensuring user experience is smooth and enjoyable. Search engine optimization to reach a larger audience. Management of the company’s social networks to ensure optimization for social media outreach and create trust between the company and customers. Studying the impact of sales promotion to guarantee customers are inclined to return.

projects.title: Senior Design Team Lead
projects.description:
●	Directed and held responsible for a team of 9 to complete, in a timely manner, a senior design project known as INART VR Project.
●	The INART VR Project consists of using Unreal Engine, C programming, test-driven development, media streaming, and video/film knowledge to create a film in collaboration with Institute For Interactive Arts, Research, & Technology department at CSULA
●	Communicate with the sponsor & team to ensure their complete satisfaction on the project
●	Continuously help the team expand their knowledge in uncharted territories

testScores.name: ETS Major Field Test for Computer Science
testScores.description:
Scoring 176/200 placed me in the 95th percentile meaning I placed in the top 5% of scorers between September 2015 and July 2019.

The ETS® Major Field Test for Computer Science consists of 66 multiple-choice questions, some of which are grouped in sets and based on materials such as diagrams, graphs and program fragments.

organizations.name: Formula SAE
organizations.description:
● Collaborate with the team to develop code for the digital dashboard program which provides essential
information to the driver
● Work with an Arduino to attempt to gather information from the vehicle such as engine rpm/vehicle speed to display on the digital dashboard
● Perform system checks on various components
● Collab with team members to solve mechanical/electrical issues and concerns and mitigating risks
● Develop proposals for potential changes to ensure all teams could accommodate this change
